final_message:
Wrote and validated the issues memorandum on Glenbrook's preference exposure report. The memo finds the report understates exposure: corrected net is about $20.11M against the report's $10.50M ($11.2M in its executive summary), and $14.73M even starting from the report's own $18.73M headline.
Main findings: the report's totals don't match its own exhibits ($24.1M of listed payees vs. $18.7M headline), the CPI wires actually went to CPI Americas, Inc. (Delaware), $1,048,000 of insider transfers were left out, the earmarking, contemporaneous-exchange, new-value and ordinary-course credits are wrong, Harborview premiums sit in a trust account for the carriers, and the filing deadline is March 15, 2027 (the report says one year) and the small-transfer floor is $7,575 (the report uses $5,000).
